external.description: Apple unveiled its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, at an event in California, but it has received a cool response from consumers in China. Priced at 15,999 yuan, many are hesitating to buy it due to comparison with local competitors and its high cost relative to income. While Apple's stock rose over 3% following the announcement, it highlights a major challenge in China, which accounts for about 17% of Apple's sales and is a fiercely competitive market dominated by local brands like Huawei and Xiaomi.
